facts.fact: The National Communications Authority's release says the Ministry of Communications and Technology, with the ITU, 'kicked off' a two-day national consultation on 12 October 2025 'to validate' the Digital Transformation Strategy (2025-2030) and to 'review and refine' the digital roadmap; no adoption is stated.

The release gives the strategy's period as 2025-2030, and as_of 2025-10-12 falls inside it; the release is a press account on the NCA site and neither links nor quotes the strategy text. Text public: not stated

note: Class national is read from the Minister's statement that the strategy will be a national framework guiding all ICT-related initiatives across sectors.
